edits.content: Route paired source/gold training through a frozen category-stratified split; learn aggregate style and geometry from training pages only; validate independently; reserve test pages until all choices are frozen. Keep source pixels as semantic authority and prohibit gold wording leakage.

Add repeat-aware PDF nativity classification, a paired split builder, aggregate gold-profile learner, OCR backend probe/fallback, the conditional Xiangshan v239 profile, and QA gates for sparse overlays, per-page pixel geometry, and non-publishable raw OCR. Preserve every incumbent reconstruction, incremental correction, exhaustive review, and cleanup behavior.
